definitions.gloss: strong flavor; rich taste; bold taste
definitions.explanation: Food or drink that has an intense, pronounced flavor — whether salty, sweet, savory, or otherwise strong in taste.

examples.japanese: {濃|こ}い{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃|こ}い{味|あじ}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: This dish has a strong flavor, so it goes well with rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄味|うすあじ}→薄味：15432_usuaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Kanto cuisine is known for its strong seasoning, but recently more people prefer lighter flavors.

notes:
A common culinary term for food with intense, pronounced flavors. ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧ means thick, dense, or strong; ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ means taste or flavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧: strong seasoning
- {濃|こ}い{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧: to like strong flavors
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧: the flavor is strong
- {濃|こ}いめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: on the stronger side (in flavor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {濃|こ}い{味|あじ} ↔ ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧/⟦{薄味|うすあじ}→薄味：15432_usuaji⟧: strong flavor vs. light/mild flavor
- {濃|こ}い{味|あじ} ↔ {淡白|たんぱく}な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: strong flavor vs. bland/subtle flavor

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese regional cuisine varies in flavor intensity. ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ (Kanto/Tokyo area) cooking is generally associated with stronger, saltier flavors, while ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ (Kansai/Osaka area) cooking is known for lighter, ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧-based seasoning, though this distinction is a generalization.
